notes.title: Nova Jumper is out now for Windows PCs!
notes.content:
Nova Jumper is now out for Windows!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601184/97942341fb5fa30c43434ec0abfcf43182743e1b.png"]
Hi everyone,
Thanks for your support in wishlisting Nova Jumper. The game is now available for Windows PCs!

I hope you enjoy playing this game as much as I enjoyed making it.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601184/e148a04117fa216bab50da4f0d290e32706be173.gif"]


Steamworks IntegrationYou can now join friends using Steam!
Once you enter a level, a lobby will open that will be open for any of your friends to join. You can also

invite friends through Steam overlay (Shift + Tab, if you didn't already know...)


VR SupportVR has been tested to work with the Oculus CV1!


Okay, that's all I've got to say for now. Thanks again for wishlisting and I hope you enjoy the game!

(Please leave a good review if you do)



Sincerely,

Paul
